sentences.en: The children were doing a project on France.
sentences.zh: [音乐] [音乐]孩子们正在做一个关于法国的项目。

sentences.en: Mrs May showed them some pictures of Paris.
sentences.zh: 太太。

sentences.en: Mrs. May showed them a picture of the Eiffel Tower.
sentences.zh: 太太。

sentences.en: "It looks very tall," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它看非常高的， 说 Biff。 Biff 说道。

sentences.en: After school Mum came to meet Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 在……之后学校妈妈来到遇见 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: Biff had a picture of Paris.
sentences.zh: Biff 拿着一张巴黎的照片。

sentences.en: "We are doing a project on France," she said.
sentences.zh: 我们是做一个项目在……上法国， 她说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: 她说。

sentences.en: Later Nadim and Anneena came to play with Biff and Chip.
sentences.zh: 后来 Nadim 和 Anneena 来到玩和……一起 Biff 和 Chip。

sentences.en: Anneena had a model of the Eiffel Tower.
sentences.zh: Anneena 有一个模型的这 Eiffel 塔。

sentences.en: "I know," Said Chip.
sentences.zh: “我知道，” Chip 说道。

sentences.en: "Let's paint the French flag."
sentences.zh: 让我们油漆这法国的旗。

sentences.en: He got a big sheet of paper and they began to paint it.
sentences.zh: 他得到一个大的床单的纸和他们开始到油漆它。

sentences.en: Suddenly the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 突然，魔法钥匙开始发光。

sentences.en: It was time for an adventure.
sentences.zh: 它是时间为了一个冒险。

sentences.en: "Oh no!" Said Biff.
sentences.zh: “哎呀，不好了。” Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "I wanted to finish painting the flag."
sentences.zh: “我想把旗子画完。”

sentences.en: The magic took them back in time.
sentences.zh: 这魔法拿他们回来在……里时间。

sentences.en: It took them to a busy town.
sentences.zh: 魔法把他们带到了一个熙熙攘攘的小镇。

sentences.en: "There are no cars," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 那里是不汽车， 说 Chip。 Chip 说道。

sentences.en: "This must be a long time ago."
sentences.zh: “这一定是很久以前的事了。”

sentences.en: "I know where we are," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 我知道哪里我们是， 说 Biff。 Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "We are in Paris.
sentences.zh: “我们身在巴黎。

sentences.en: Look at all the flags." Anneena was excited.
sentences.zh: 看看这些旗帜。” Anneena 是兴奋的。

sentences.en: "We can go and see the Eiffel Tower," she said.
sentences.zh: 我们能去和看见这 Eiffel 塔， 她说。

sentences.en: She said.
sentences.zh: 她说。

sentences.en: The children looked for the Eiffel Tower but they couldn't find it.
sentences.zh: 孩子们寻找着埃菲尔铁塔，但他们找不到。

sentences.en: "Are you sure this is Paris?" Asked Chip.
sentences.zh: “你确定这里是巴黎吗？” Chip 问道。

sentences.en: Nadim asked a policeman.
sentences.zh: Nadim 问一个男警察。

sentences.en: "Do you know where the Eiffel Tower is?" He asked.
sentences.zh: “你知道埃菲尔铁塔在哪里吗？” 他问。

sentences.en: "The Eiffel Tower!" Said the policeman.
sentences.zh: “埃菲尔铁塔，” 警察说道。

sentences.en: "There is no such thing."
sentences.zh: “根本没有这种东西。”

sentences.en: Anneena asked a lady.
sentences.zh: Anneena 问一个女士。

sentences.en: "Do you know where the Eiffel Tower is?" She asked.
sentences.zh: “你知道埃菲尔铁塔在哪里吗？” 她问道。

sentences.en: "The Eiffel Tower!" Said the lady.
sentences.zh: “埃菲尔铁塔，” 那位女士说。

sentences.en: "There is no such thing."
sentences.zh: “根本没有这种东西。”

sentences.en: "I know why we can't find the Eiffel Tower," Said Biff.
sentences.zh: “我知道我们为什么找不到埃菲尔铁塔。” Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "It hasn't been invented."
sentences.zh: “它还没有被发明出来。”

sentences.en: Just then they saw a man.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，她们看见了一个男人。

sentences.en: He was pulling a cart.
sentences.zh: 他正在拉一辆手推车。

sentences.en: "Will you help?" Asked the man.
sentences.zh: “你们能帮帮忙吗？” 那个人问道。

sentences.en: "I can't get the cart up this step."
sentences.zh: “我没办法把手推车拉上这个台阶。”

sentences.en: The children helped the man pull the cart into a hall.
sentences.zh: 这孩子们帮助这男人拉这大车进入一个门厅。

sentences.en: The man pulled a sheet off the cart.
sentences.zh: 这男人拉一个床单离开这大车。

sentences.en: "This is my model," he said.
sentences.zh: 这个是我的模型， 他说。

sentences.en: "What is it?" Asked Nadim.
sentences.zh: “这是什么？” Nadim 问道。

sentences.en: "It is a torch," said the man.
sentences.zh: 它是一个手电筒， 说这男人。 那人说道。

sentences.en: "It will be taller than all the houses in Paris.
sentences.zh: “它将比巴黎的所有房子都高。

sentences.en: People will see it for miles.
sentences.zh: 人们在几英里外就能看到它。

sentences.en: Here is a picture.
sentences.zh: 这是一张图片。

sentences.en: It will look like this."
sentences.zh: 它看起来会是这样的。”

sentences.en: The children looked round the hall.
sentences.zh: 孩子们环视大厅。

sentences.en: There were lots of models.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多模型。

sentences.en: "It's a competition," said Chip.
sentences.zh: 它是一个竞争， 说 Chip。 Chip 说道。

sentences.en: "I know which one will win, the Eiffel Tower. Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 我知道哪个一将赢。。。 这 Eiffel 塔！

sentences.en: "But I can't see the Eiffel Tower," said Nadim.
sentences.zh: 我不能看见这 Eiffel 塔， 说 Nadim。

sentences.en: Some people began to look at the models to see which was the best. Said the man.
sentences.zh: 有些人开始看模型，想看看哪个最好。 那人说道。

sentences.en: "Everyone will see my torch for miles," said the man.
sentences.zh: 每个人将看见我的手电筒为了英里， 说这男人。

sentences.en: "At night the top will light up like this!"
sentences.zh: “到了晚上，顶部会像这样亮起来。”

sentences.en: He plugged in the torch.
sentences.zh: 他把火炬插上电。

sentences.en: There was a loud bang.
sentences.zh: 一声巨响传来。

sentences.en: The top of the torch blew off.
sentences.zh: 火炬的顶部炸飞了。

sentences.en: Then it fell over with a crash.
sentences.zh: 然后它砰的一声倒了下来。

sentences.en: "Uh," "Ah!" said the man.
sentences.zh: “哎哟！”

sentences.en: "It needs a little work."
sentences.zh: 它必须一个小的工作。

sentences.en: Danina had an idea.
sentences.zh: 阿尼娜有了一个主意。

sentences.en: She began to lift the broken torch.
sentences.zh: 她开始抬起坏掉的火炬。

sentences.en: "Help me, everyone," she said.
sentences.zh: 帮助我， 每个人， 她说。

sentences.en: The children turned the torch upside down.
sentences.zh: 孩子们把火炬倒了过来。

sentences.en: "What does it look like to you?" Asked Danina.
sentences.zh: “你觉得它像什么？” 阿尼娜问道。

sentences.en: "It looks like the Eiffel Tower," said Biff.
sentences.zh: 它看喜欢这 Eiffel 塔， 说 Biff。

sentences.en: She spoke to the man.
sentences.zh: 她对那位男士说道。

sentences.en: "Excuse me," She said.
sentences.zh: “你说什么？

sentences.en: "Why not make the torch into a tower?"
sentences.zh: “为什么不把火炬做成一座塔呢？”

sentences.en: "Excuse me," Said Danina.
sentences.zh: “你说什么？

sentences.en: But is your name Eiffel?" "Brilliant!" Said the man.
sentences.zh: “不过，您叫埃菲尔吗？” “太棒了，” 那人说道。

sentences.en: "Brilliant!"
sentences.zh: “太棒了，”

sentences.en: Just then the magic key began to glow.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，魔法钥匙开始发光。

sentences.en: "I wonder if that was Monsieur Eiffel," said Biff.
sentences.zh: “我想知道那是不是埃菲尔先生，”Biff 说。 Biff 说道。

sentences.en: "And if that was how the Eiffel Tower was invented!" Said Nadim.
sentences.zh: “如果这就是埃菲尔铁塔的发明过程呢！”Nadim 说道。
